purpose: Original synthetic acceptance inputs and expected outcomes; not an application import format or evidence of passed tests.

facts: Wrote SQL queries for incident analysis

opportunity.title: Signal Operations Engineer
opportunity.description: Maintain Linux operational procedures and query incident records with SQL. Kubernetes experience preferred. Work authorization required; employer does not supply country details in this fixture.

evidence.text: Wrote SQL queries for incident analysis

cases.given: Reviewed Linux/SQL evidence exists but there is no posting, application, model route or provider account.
cases.when: Create a deterministic base resume from profile revision 1, review, edit, restore and export it.
then: No inference or provider network call occurs
Base resume has no application or posting dependency
Every factual block pins reviewed claim/evidence revisions
Edit and restore append revisions; live profile edits cannot alter old exports
Unsupported manual additions block PDF under the same rules as tailored output

cases.given: Browser has a system color preference and initially no explicit override.
cases.when: Choose the opposite theme and reload; repeat with preference storage denied.
then: Unset preference follows the system
Explicit override survives reload when storage is available
Storage denial leaves usable session-only theme with an accurate persistence limitation
UI theme never changes document rendering style

cases.given: An authenticated owner has reviewed the two evidence statements and the opportunity requirements.
cases.when: Save opportunity, generate a supported resume and letter, review, export PDF and record application stage applied manually.
then: Linux and SQL factual text references EV-LINUX-1 and EV-SQL-1 revision 1
No Kubernetes experience or invented percentage appears
Work authorization remains unknown
Two initial document drafts are published atomically
PDF export is not an email send
Application stage history records owner-authored applied event

cases.given: Only the two provided evidence records exist.
cases.when: A model or manual edit adds 'Led Kubernetes migration reducing incidents by 45%'.
then: Unsupported experience and numeric claim flagged
No profile skill silently added
PDF export blocked until statement removed or genuine supporting evidence reviewed
Citing unrelated SQL evidence does not establish semantic support

cases.when: First commits version 4 and second submits If-Match quoted 3.
then: Second gets 412
First edit remains intact
User can compare local unsaved changes and reload
A delayed save cannot recreate a deleted entry

cases.given: The configured local model is offline and hosted egress is disabled.
then: Visible unavailable or retryable failure within declared timeout
No automatic hosted fallback
No zero fit or invented document result
Manual profile editing and tracking still work

cases.given: Worker A holds fence 7 and begins a slow model call.
cases.when: Cancel commits before A publishes, or lease expires and worker B reclaims with fence 8.
then: A late fence-7 output cannot commit
Cancelled run cannot publish document pair
Staged orphan blob is reclaimed only after safe retention window
No status reports successful cancellation before safe checkpoint

cases.given: A portable manifest and separate encrypted installation backup include linked synthetic profile/application/document artifacts.
cases.when: Tamper one artifact hash, validate, then restore the intact installation backup on a disposable host with correct keys.
then: Tampered archive rejects before live writes
Intact recovery preserves all referenced versions and artifact bytes
Missing key fails explicitly
Sessions and external permissions are revalidated
Export excludes secrets and is not advertised as full installation backup

cases.given: One reviewed synthetic board returns external job 001 and later a duplicate observation or a 429.
then: One external source key maps to one observation identity
Changed text creates attributable freshness/version state
429 preserves earlier results and honors bounded Retry-After
Similar title at a different location is not destructively merged

cases.given: Hosted provider opt-in is false and profile contains private notes and reference contact information.

then: No hosted request before approval
Private notes and reference contacts excluded from ordinary projection
Approval binds route, input digest, revision and expiry
Changed projection invalidates old approval
Consent is not a general future-send permission

then: Exactly one owner exists

Mutation with missing CSRF or wrong Origin rejects
Secrets do not appear in logs

then: Extraction is an untrusted proposal
Duplicate/conflicting facts require review
Instructions have no authority

then: Ambiguous/nonexistent local time requires explicit disambiguation or correction

then: Extracted PDF text preserves supported facts
